title: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
author: Luo Guanzhong
protagonist: Liu Bei and the Shu-Han cause

beats.event: Peach Garden Oath binds Liu Bei, Guan Yu, and Zhang Fei as brothers
Help crush the Yellow Turban Rebellion but receive scant reward
Loses Xu Province to Cao Cao and is forced to flee
Takes refuge under governor Liu Biao in Jing Province
Visits Zhuge Liang thrice and recruits him as chief strategist
Cao Cao's southern campaign routs Liu Bei's forces at Changban
Zhao Yun rescues infant Liu Shan as Zhang Fei holds the bridge
Sun-Liu alliance wins the decisive Battle of Red Cliffs
Gains southern Jing Province in the aftermath
Seizes Yi Province from Liu Zhang per the Longzhong Plan
Defeats Cao Cao at Hanzhong; declares himself King of Hanzhong
Founds Shu Han and proclaims himself emperor of a restored Han
Guan Yu ambushed by Sun Quan's forces and executed
Zhang Fei assassinated in his sleep by his own subordinates
Lu Xun burns Liu Bei's revenge army at the Battle of Yiling
Liu Bei dies of illness at Baidicheng, entrusting Shu to Zhuge Liang
Zhuge Liang's five Northern Expeditions fail; he dies at Wuzhang Plains
Jiang Wei's nine follow-up campaigns yield no lasting gain
Under Liu Shan, Shu is conquered by Wei and the Han cause ends
